events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber's MLB-leading 39th homer of the season was a two-run shot with two out in the bottom of the ninth inning as the Philadelphia Phillies rallied from a four-run deficit and beat the St. Louis Cardinals 6-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber's 2-run HR with 2 out in 9th rallies Phillies for a 6-4 win over the Cardinals

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Nick Martinez pitched six innings of one-hit ball, Junior Caminero and Chandler Simpson delivered RBI singles in the pivotal sixth inning and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Baltimore Orioles 3-1 Sunday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Martinez allows 1 hit in 6 innings as Rays avert sweep with 3-1 win over Orioles

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit a bases-loaded single to score two runs and cap a three-run sixth inning, and the New York Yankees pulled away for an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ben Rice hits two-run single to cap 3-run sixth as Yankees pull away for 8-3 victory over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Xavier Edwards hit a go-ahead two-run single in the fifth inning and the Miami Marlins beat the Washington Nationals 6-2 on Sunday to complete a three-game series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards hits go-ahead single to lift Marlins to win over Nationals and series sweep

headlines.description: — Max Muncy hit a go-ahead solo homer in the seventh inning and the Athletics rallied from a six-run deficit to beat the Houston Astros 7-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Muncy's solo homer caps off A's rally as Oakland beats Houston 7-6

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Nick Loftin and John Rave homered, Kyle Isbel drove in three runs and the Kansas City Royals extended their winning streak to eight games with an 11-7 victory over the Detroit Tigers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Loftin and Rave HRs, Isbel's 3 RBIs help Royals win 8th straight game, 11-7 over Tigers

events.name: New York Mets at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters homered with one out in the ninth inning to give the Chicago White Sox a 2-1 victory over the New York Mets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tristan Peters homers in the ninth inning to give the White Sox a 2-1 win over the Mets

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Ezequiel Durán and Elias Díaz hit solo homers, Cal Quantrill worked six scoreless innings and the Texas Rangers beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durán and Díaz homers, Quantrill's 6 scoreless innings help Rangers beat Angels 5-3

headlines.description: — Chase DeLauter had two triples and drove in two runs, Jo Adell had two RBI and the Cleveland Guardians rolled past the Colorado Rockies 7-2 on Sunday to finish a sweep of their three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chase DeLauter hits 2 triples and the Guardians beat the Rockies 7-2 to sweep their 3-game series

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Nick Sogard hit his second career homer, Jake Bennett struck out six in seven innings and the Boston Red Sox came back to finish a sweep of the San Francisco Giants with a 5-4 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sogard's solo homer starts Red Sox rally in 5-4 win over Giants

headlines.description: — Ian Happ and Pedro Ramírez each hit grand slams and had five RBI, Pete Crow-Armstrong also homered and the Chicago Cubs blew out the Seattle Mariners 19-2 on Sunday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Happ and Ramírez hit grand slams to propel the Cubs to a 19-2 blowout of the Mariners

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. hit two homers and drove in four runs for the red-hot San Diego Padres, who beat the Minnesota Twins 8-1 Sunday for a three-game sweep in a showdown of teams pushing for wild-card spots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tatis homers twice, drives in 4 runs to lead Padres to 8-1 win, 3-game sweep of Twins

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Ildemaro Vargas hit a go-ahead, two-run triple in a decisive four-run seventh inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied for a 5-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Sunday to win the series and keep pace in the National League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ildemaro Vargas' 2-run triple highlights rally that pushes the Diamondbacks past Reds 5-3

venue.fullName: Journey Bank Ballpark at Historic Bowman Field

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II hit a solo homer, Mauricio Dubon had an RBI ground-rule double and Tyler Mahle worked five strong innings as the Atlanta Braves beat the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2 in the Little League Classic on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris homers, Mahle pitches 5 strong innings as Braves beat Brewers 4-2 in Little League Classic
